text:
emma: tiny holiday brainstorm — 'mini wreath decorating' + 4pm tea/cheers? post a photo of your wreath or hat. prizes: best tiny wreath and best silly hat. :wreath: :tophat:
noor: i'm making a 2-minute wreath out of leftover ribbons. i'll post pics. :scissors:
dev: i'll bring extra ribbon at HQ. can someone pin a simple rules list? short and silly is the vibe.
bri: vote idea: use reactions. :star: = best wreath, :laughing: = silliest hat. i'll start a quick poll: /poll "Wreath + hat at 16:00?" "Yes" "No" "Maybe"
cheer-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Yes. Reminder: Mini wreath & hat at 16:00 UTC. Upload to #random.
emma: i'll pin the rules: 1) max 5 minutes to assemble 2) keep safe 3) post photo by 15:50 for slideshow.
noor: posted my ribbon wreath (not shown here). caption: '5 minute ribbon miracle'. :sparkles:
dev: i'll place ribbons in kitchen at 15:30 for anyone at HQ.
bri: uploading my ridiculous tinfoil top hat. caption: 'crowning achievement'. :crown:
cheer-bot: Event ended: photos received 7. Winners by reactions: best wreath = noor, silliest hat = bri. Congrats! :tada:
